cards.say: Five times two equals ten. Two groups of five.
Five times three equals fifteen. Three groups of five.
Five times four equals twenty. Four groups of five.
Five times five equals twenty-five. Five groups of five.
Five times six equals thirty. Six groups of five.
Five times seven equals thirty-five. Seven groups of five.
Five times eight equals forty. Eight groups of five.
Five times nine equals forty-five. Nine groups of five.
Five times ten equals fifty. Ten groups of five.

cards.front: Numbers in the 5 times table always end in...
cards.say: Numbers in the five times table always end in zero or five.
Count in fives to fifty. Five, ten, fifteen, twenty, twenty-five, thirty, thirty-five, forty, forty-five, fifty.
Four rows of five. Four times five equals twenty.

figure.alt: An array of four rows with five dots in each row.

cards.say: Ten divided by five equals two. Two times five equals ten.
Fifteen divided by five equals three. Three times five equals fifteen.
Twenty divided by five equals four. Four times five equals twenty.
Twenty-five divided by five equals five. Five times five equals twenty-five.
Thirty divided by five equals six. Six times five equals thirty.
Thirty-five divided by five equals seven. Seven times five equals thirty-five.
Forty divided by five equals eight. Eight times five equals forty.

cards.front: 4 hands. How many fingers altogether if each hand has 5?
cards.say: Four hands, five fingers on each. How many fingers altogether? Twenty fingers. Four times five equals twenty.

cards.front: A 5-pack of pencils: 3 packs. How many pencils?
cards.say: There are five pencils in a pack. Three packs. How many pencils? Fifteen pencils. Three times five equals fifteen.
Fact family for two, five and ten. Two times five equals ten. Five times two equals ten. Ten divided by two equals five. Ten divided by five equals two.
Is thirty-five in the five times table? Yes. Seven times five equals thirty-five and it ends in five.

cards.back: No. It does not end in 0 or 5.
cards.say: Is forty-two in the five times table? No. It does not end in zero or five.

cards.back: The same answer, 50. Order does not change the answer.
cards.say: Ten times five and five times ten are the same answer, fifty. Order does not change the answer.
